ann (Product Designer): Quick sync on Playground streaming UI — Figma link in thread. Need a fast decision on three things: button wording (Stop vs Interrupt vs Pause), token counter placement (inline vs floating pill), and whether the prompt library should be interactive during a run. PTAL.

leo (Frontend): Strong preference for a floating token pill anchored to the right rail. Keeps message flow stable and avoids layout shifts. Compact while streaming, expands to breakdown on finish.

sam (Engineering): Agreed on pill. Also implementation note: cancel is final on the server so "Pause" is misleading. Recommend "Stop generation" or "Interrupt"; I prefer "Stop generation" for clarity.

odette (A11y): Accessibility checks: if we pick "Stop generation" add aria-label="Stop generation, partial response may be returned" and an aria-live="polite" region for chunk updates. Coalesce updates so screen readers aren't spammed.

ann (Product Designer): Good call. I'll use "Stop generation" for the visible CTA and put the nuance in tooltip: "Stops generation. Partial response may be returned. Use Regenerate to start over." For prompt library: allow browsing but disable the Apply CTA with inline note "Applies to next run."

leo (Frontend): Implementation plan: pill shows token count + small indeterminate ring during stream. Debounce updates to ~200ms. Disabled Apply buttons should be focusable with aria-disabled="true" and a tooltip pointing to the "applies to next run" copy.

devops-bot: Deploy queued: branch playground/stream-ui -> staging at 2024-08-12 02:00 UTC

ann (Product Designer): Action items: leo prototype by EOD Wed, odette to review accessibility strings after prototype, sam to confirm cancel semantics with infra. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
